contributions.statement: Pilot an AI code reviewer as one subagent per quality dimension (readability, maintainability, reliability, performance), each with its own antipattern checklist and diff plus dependency-graph context from MCP; on real industrial commits developers rated 96% of findings correct, but measure recall separately because nobody did here.
contributions.evidence: Table 7: 197/206 findings rated correct by the commits' own developers; Table 8: 65 must-fix, 70 should-fix, 62 minor; 7 commits, 5 raters, no recall, no single-agent baseline (§5.1).

contributions.statement: Expect about a third of even correct AI review findings to be minor; triage by importance before routing findings to developers.

reason: Small but real industrial evidence that a dimension-split reviewer is precise as judged by code owners; the mechanism (knowledge graph, decomposition) and recall are unmeasured, so it supports a pilot, not a gate.
